posts.title: No, PS/2 DBA disks are not ESDI
posts.description: One of the most common questions I get from people is "Can I put the ESDI-Emu in my PS/2 Models 50/55/70?" Sadly, the answer is no . Why not? Because the PS/2 Models 50/55/70 doesn't use ESDI disk drives. IBM wanted a physically small disk drive that wouldn't require a separate controller.
